scope: Visual inspection of the five previously flagged low-text PDF pages in two Zwemer books. This is not a full-book accuracy review.
method: PyMuPDF 1.28.2 render at 130 DPI, visual comparison against existing extracted text; enlarged folio crops for the Moslem Christ pages.
conclusion: All five flags are chapter-divider pages. Their complete chapter headings are already in the existing text layer. Low character counts do not indicate missing prose. Two small folio numbers were not captured; they are retained below as locator metadata. No OCR or restoration is necessary for these flags.
rights: Existing source-rights qualifications unchanged. No public hosting, redistribution, or full-text indexing clearance is asserted.
